title: Allowance Settled Against a Granite Ridge Carry-Forward Fee for the Part of the Season Already Run
content:
How much of the season has already run on the handling date settles an allowance against the figure carried into that step of a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme carry-forward fee.

**First.** Where fewer than a quarter of the season's days have run on the handling date, an allowance of 20.00 is settled against it.

**Second.** Where at least a quarter but fewer than half of the season's days have run on the handling date, an allowance of 10.00 is settled against it.

**Otherwise.** In any other case no allowance is settled against it by this rule.

### The season's days and the two marks

The season's days are counted from the day the season opened to the day it closes. On a season running from 2026-11-20 to 2027-04-18 that is 149 days, so the quarter mark falls once 38 days have run and the half mark once 75 days have run.

| Days of the season run on the handling date, against 149 | Allowance settled |
| --- | --- |
| 37 | 20.00 |
| 38 | 10.00 |
| 74 | 10.00 |
| 75 | none by this rule |

The allowance is a figure in USD settled against the figure carried into this step, not a percentage of it, and the same two figures of 20.00 and 10.00 apply whatever the tier.

### Worked on a hypothetical election

An election handled on 20 December on a season that opened on 2026-11-20: 30 days of the season have run, below the quarter mark of 38, so 20.00 is settled against the figure carried into this step. An election handled on 1 February, with 73 days run, falls between the two marks and 10.00 is settled instead.
